title: Workflow Composition Declaration
description: Shape of the optional `composition` array on a workflow registry entry. Each entry names one reusable track to execute and how its input is assembled from the workflow input and earlier track results.

as.description: Unique alias under which this track's result enters the workflow artifact bag

input_map.description: Object map of field -> $input[.path] or $artifacts.<alias>[.path] references (same resolver as step input maps)

on_failure.description: abort (default) fails the workflow plan; skip records the failure and continues with remaining entries
